meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 接到分诊指令后，Claude 会扫一遍仓库所有未关闭的 issue 和 PR，每一项都由一个后台子任务分析并写出报告到 /tmp 的日期时间目录；报告中每条结论都要附上指向代码具体位置的 GitHub 链接。Claude 全程只读，不评论、不合并、不关闭任何 GitHub 内容。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs”等触发词时启动。

say.text: 帮我把这个仓库所有打开的 issue 和 PR 都分诊一遍。
say.note: 扫描全部未关闭项并为每项生成报告，不改动 GitHub。
只分析打开的 issue，每项写一份带链接的报告。

say.text: triage PRs，重点看还没合并的。
say.note: 为每个打开的 PR 生成审查报告，标记合并就绪情况。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude scans all open issues and PRs, spawns a background subagent per item to analyze/classify it, and writes reports to a dated /tmp folder. Every claim must carry a GitHub permalink. Read-only: never comments, merges, closes, or edits on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', etc.

say_en.text: Please triage all open issues and PRs in this repo.
say_en.note: Scans every open item and writes reports; no GitHub changes.
Analyzes each open issue and writes an evidence-backed report.

say_en.text: triage PRs, focus on unmerged ones.
say_en.note: Produces one review report per open PR.
